{{Disambig|Gold}}

==Towers==
'''Gold''' may refer to these towers:
*[[Golden Cowboy]], an upgraded version of the [[Cowboy]]
**[[Golden Cowboy/History]]
*[[Golden Crook Boss]], an upgraded version of the [[Crook Boss]]
**[[Golden Crook Boss/History]]
*[[Golden Minigunner]], an upgraded version of the [[Minigunner]]
**[[Golden Minigunner/History]]
*[[Golden Pyromancer]], an upgraded version of the [[Pyromancer]]
**[[Golden Pyromancer/History]]
*[[Golden Scout]], an upgraded version of the [[Scout]]
**[[Golden Scout/History]]
*[[Golden Soldier]], an upgraded version of the [[Soldier]]
**[[Golden Soldier/History]]
*[[Golden Snowballer]], an upgraded version of the [[Snowballer]] exclusive to developers
*[[Golden Demoman]], an upgraded version of the [[Demoman]]

==Enemies==
'''Gold''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Golden]], an enemy that appears on Wave 20 in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, which is exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.
*[[Gold Guard]], a guardian enemy that appears on Wave 40 in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, which is exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.
*[[Gold Titan]], a major boss that appears on Wave 40 in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, which is exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.

'''Gold''' may refer to these exclusive enemies:
*[[Golden Mystery]], an exclusive enemy that spawns every modern enemy upon death.

==Units==
'''Gold''' may refer to these units:
*[[Golden Pistol Goon]], a unit spawned by the Level 0-4 [[Golden Crook Boss]]
*[[Golden Tommy Goon 1]], a unit spawned by the Level 3 [[Golden Crook Boss]]
*[[Golden Tommy Goon 2]], a unit spawned by the Level 4 [[Golden Crook Boss]]

It may also refer to these removed units:
*[[Golden Crook]], a unit that was spawned by the Level 2-3 [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]]
*[[Golden Mafia]], a unit that was spawned by the Level 4 [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]]
*[[Golden Body Guard]], a unit that was spawned by the Level 2 [[Golden Crook Boss]]
*[[Golden Body Guards 1]], a unit that was spawned by the Level 3 [[Golden Crook Boss]]
*[[Golden Body Guards 2]], a unit that was spawned by the Level 4 [[Golden Crook Boss]]
